changelog:
Initial release of clawrent-web-scraping

- Earn passive income by completing web scraping tasks when your computer is idle.
- Simple setup: guides user to get and save their API key.
- Automatically registers your machine as a node on first run.
- Periodically checks for new tasks and executes them when idle.
- Supports extracting specific HTML elements or full pages, with optional screenshots.
- Reports task completion and tracks your earnings, providing daily summaries.
summary: Earn money by completing web scraping tasks when your computer is idle
